project_summary: A lead-generation and payments platform with auth, admin controls, lead extraction jobs, saved searches, credits, and payment history.
discovery_goals: Suggest features grounded in the current backend API surface and frontend pages/components.
Prefer user-facing improvements that connect an existing backend capability to a missing frontend flow, or add a small new backend and frontend capability on top of an existing module.
Return multiple candidate features instead of a single suggestion when the project context supports them.
backend_context: Auth routes support registration, login, profile updates, and JWT-based authorization.
Lead generation includes jobs, leads download, credits balance/history, saved searches, and retry flows.
Admin routes support user management, credit approvals, stats, and job retry controls.
Payments routes support packages, order creation, verification, history, and history export.
frontend_context: Frontend has admin, auth, lead generation, payment history, job details, saved searches, and credits history pages/components.
Lead details already support CSV download from the job details view.
Payment history already supports export, but filtering and richer workflows can still be added.

feature_templates.title: Add failed job retry controls
acceptance_criteria: Users can retry failed lead generation jobs from the main jobs list
Admins can trigger a retry for failed jobs from the admin dashboard
Retry eligibility is enforced so completed or running jobs cannot be retried
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add payment history export
acceptance_criteria: Users can export their payment history from the payment history screen
Backend returns a downloadable payment history export scoped to the authenticated user
The export includes credits purchased, payment status, and timestamps
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add saved search alerts
acceptance_criteria: Users can enable alerts for a saved search
Backend stores alert preferences per saved search
Frontend shows alert status and lets users toggle alerts from the saved searches panel
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add credit history export
acceptance_criteria: Users can export their credit history from the credits history view
Backend returns a CSV export of the authenticated user's credit ledger history
Frontend exposes the export action next to the existing credits history table
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add admin user search and status filters
acceptance_criteria: Admins can filter users by email query, admin flag, and active status
Backend accepts filter parameters for the users list endpoint
Frontend exposes the filters in the admin users tab
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add payment history filters
acceptance_criteria: Users can filter payment history by status and package
Backend accepts filter parameters for payment history
Frontend exposes filter controls above the payment history table
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add a marketing landing page refresh
acceptance_criteria: The product gets a clearer entry landing page with product value and call-to-action sections
Existing auth and dashboard routes continue to work
Frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add payment package comparison and recommendation UI
acceptance_criteria: Users can compare available credit packages with better plan context
Frontend highlights a recommended package based on current pricing data
Payment purchase flow remains unchanged and regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Improve payment status and recovery experience
acceptance_criteria: Users get a clearer payment success, pending, and failed status experience
The payment status page suggests next actions for retry or support
Payment regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add profile security settings
acceptance_criteria: Users can manage password or security-related profile settings from the profile page
Backend validates and stores the change safely
Auth and profile regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add richer job details insights
acceptance_criteria: Users can see richer summary metrics and lead quality context on job details
Existing job and lead retrieval endpoints continue to support the page
Lead generation regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add a dedicated saved search management page
acceptance_criteria: Users can manage saved searches on a dedicated page instead of only inside the lead generator form
Saved searches can still be reused and deleted
Saved search regression suites remain green
